item.title: What you compare is what you get: Did Modi cost Indians $1,000 a year?
item.description: Grier and Grier report that Indian income per head ended 2023 about $1,000 below its synthetic counterfactual. Widening the pool of comparison countries, switching to the GDP series the Penn World Table recommends for growth comparisons, or fitting growth rates rather than levels each flips the sign.

Welcome to my website! I am a second year Ph.D. student in economics at the University of California, Berkeley. I am interested in political economy and development economics, and have previously worked on conflict and political reservations in India, democratic transitions and state repression, and longevity. Before my Ph.D., I worked as a predoc with Robin Burgess and Oriana Bandiera at the LSE, where I also did a masters in economics.
Some old projects are on the dedicated page.
